ambiguous_cities.description: Place names with more than one well-known referent. A hit is a signal to withhold a coordinate, not to assign one. See the Cambridge slide.

holocaust_camps.description: Camp and killing-site names appearing in testimony.
holocaust_camps.handling: Names only. No victim, survivor or location-of-death data. Safe to publish.

geonouns.description: Common nouns denoting geographical or built features. Unnamed geography: the layer a toponym list cannot hold.

family_terms.description: Kinship terms. Tier 3 (family relations), deferred: relation-level adjudication is out of scope for now.

non_verbals.description: Interview transcription markers. Used at SEGMENTATION, not annotation: these must not be inside an evidence quote, and a span that contains one is suspect.
